description:
Migrate the gf2-coding library consumers of `ExtendedBchCode` — the GRAND, fading, and product paths — to the generic one-symbol extension of canonical BCH codes.

## Background

`ExtendedBchCode` is a binary, matrix-materializing wrapper coupled to the legacy `BchCode`. Behavioral pins: the extended parity-check agreement fixtures from the extension-transformation task and the existing eBCH reference-vector tests. The wrapper type itself is deleted in the final removal sweep once external consumers are migrated.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The GRAND, fading, and product library paths consume the generic extension with unchanged observable results, including the eBCH reference-vector tests.
- [hard] REQ-02: No gf2-coding library path constructs `ExtendedBchCode` any longer.
title: Migrate library eBCH consumers to the generic extension
